user: I am still asking about that same non-delivery issue.
answer:
What I did
- Reviewed our earlier conversation and the Verta dispute guidance we pulled.

What I found
- The dispute classification we recorded for this non-delivery issue is: goods_not_received.
- Per our tariff/KB, that reason code uses a 90-day window from the transaction date.

What happens next
- I will not open a dispute unless you ask me to. If you want me to open one, please provide the transaction ID, exact amount and currency, and the transaction date so I can check eligibility (and then run the eligibility check and open the dispute if you confirm).
- If you don’t have the transaction ID, I can send an account statement to the email on file to help you locate it — confirm if you want me to send that to your registered address.
- If you’d prefer a human agent at any time, say so and I’ll escalate.
